title: Three nonnegative information terms certify the physical 2+1 block case
statement: For an actual block-diagonal state B direct-sum C on C^2 direct-sum C, the W3 entropy slack is Delta_cond + Delta_mix + g(c), with each term nonnegative.

requires: Normalized state rho=B direct-sum C on a physical 2+1 qutrit decomposition and arbitrary finite reference R.
provides: The entropy inequality and exact equality characterization for every state in this block-diagonal class.
assumptions: No cross-sector coherence; use the source's homogeneous unnormalized entropy convention for the positive blocks.
costs: Exact entropy algebra; no physical or computational resource claim.
contract.obstruction: Does not handle coherence between the physical 2D and 1D sectors or settle the unrestricted target.

evidence.status: Exact selected source bytes; internal acceptance applies only through a version-bound overlay.

evidence.quote: Equality holds exactly when ρ=I3/3 tensor τ for some reference state τ. In particular every nonproduct state in this block-diagonal class has strict inequality, including states whose B block is entangled.

body: The first remainder is a conditional-entropy concavity gap, the second a Holevo information, and the scalar remainder a binary relative entropy. The equality proof requires the positive mixture weights and strict entropy concavity stated in the source.

review.scope: Only physical 2+1 block-diagonal states; arbitrary coherence remains outside scope.
